name_de: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE44 HPC SLT 800
name_en: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE44 HPC SLT 800
description_de: Das Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE44 HPC SLT 800 ist ein vollgefedertes E-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX-R) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist, bedient wird er über Bosch Kiox 400C. Federung: Fox 36 Float Factory GRIPX2, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 150mm · Dämpfer Fox Float X Factory, 230x60mm (27.5: 210x55mm), Adjustable LSC/LSR…. Schaltung: Sram XX Eagle AXS™ Transmission, 12-Speed. Bremsen: Magura Race Pro, Front 4-Piston/Rear 4-Piston, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Rahmen: Carbon Front Triangle. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE44 HPC SLT 800 is a full-suspension electric mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX-R) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery, controlled via Bosch Kiox 400C. Suspension: Fox 36 Float Factory GRIPX2, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 150mm · Dämpfer Fox Float X Factory, 230x60mm (27.5: 210x55mm), Adjustable LSC/LSR…. Drivetrain: Sram XX Eagle AXS™ Transmission, 12-Speed. Brakes: Magura Race Pro, Front 4-Piston/Rear 4-Piston, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Frame: Carbon Front Triangle. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
motorDetails: Bosch Drive Unit Performance Line CX-R max. 120Nm (BDU38)
